Our Story

A Unique A-Frame
Escape In Wayanad

Tucked into the lush green hills of Mananthavady, The Western Inn rises like no other — a dramatic A-frame structure that feels both architectural marvel and intimate forest hideaway. The sharp triangular silhouette cuts against the sky while warm amber light spills from every window.

This is not a resort that blends in. It was built to stand apart — for travellers who seek beauty in the unexpected, who want their holiday to feel like a memory they'll carry for years. Whether you arrive as a couple or a family, The Western Inn offers the rare luxury of feeling completely at home while being somewhere extraordinary.

Every corner has been designed with care: private balconies overlooking the canopy, outdoor seating that comes alive at dusk, and interiors that balance warmth with understated elegance.
